# zkVM protocol vectors

Verbatim copies from [davinci-zkvm](https://github.com/vocdoni/davinci-zkvm) at
v0.5.0 (commit `22dbedff4e67a352c751acde7a3158f8685d6098`: the ballot proof with 71
public inputs, the Keccak census tree, the vote envelope vector and the
pre-production ceremony ballot key of davinci-circom v1.3.0; `ballots.json` and
`leanimt.json` are unchanged since `867316bb`). The Rust SDK tests against the same files, and its code is what
`src/crypto` and `src/protocol` mirror. Do not edit or reformat them: the tests compare byte for byte, and the
checksums below identify the copy.

| File | Source | Used by |
|---|---|---|
| `poseidon.json` | `rust-sdk/testdata/` (go-iden3-crypto) | `test/crypto/unit/Poseidon.test.ts` |
| `babyjubjub.json`, `elgamal.json` | `rust-sdk/testdata/` | `BabyJubJub.test.ts`, `Ballot.test.ts` |
| `ballot_mode.json`, `ballots.json` | `rust-sdk/testdata/` (`ballots.json`: 1, 2, 6, 8 and 16 fields with their 71 public signals) | `Ballot.test.ts`, `RealProver.test.ts` |
| `real_proof.json` | `rust-sdk/testdata/` (a 6-field proof under the pinned key, its 71 public signals) | `Ballot.test.ts`, `VkHash.test.ts`, `test/prover/unit/*` |
| `hashes.json`, `genesis.json` | `rust-sdk/testdata/` | `VkHash.test.ts` |
| `hashes.json` `vote_envelope` | `rust-sdk/testdata/` (go-sdk `sdk-vectors`) | `Ecdsa.test.ts` |
| `ballot_proof_vkey.json` | `rust-sdk/assets/` (davinci-circom `artifacts/ballot_proof_vkey.json` at v1.3.0, the ceremony key) | `VkHash.test.ts`, `test/prover/unit/*` (its sha256 is the artifact table's) |
| `leanimt.json`, `census.json`, `slot.json` | `rust-sdk/testdata/` (Go reference; `leanimt.json` holds Keccak trees as `0x` hex, most roots above the BN254 modulus) | `Census.test.ts`, `Ecdsa.test.ts` |
| `dkg_schnorr.json` | `rust-sdk/testdata/` (davinci-dkg) | `Dkg.test.ts` |
| `limits.rs`, `release.rs` | `rust-sdk/src/` | `test/protocol/unit/Protocol.test.ts` |

The JSON vectors are generated by `go-sdk/cmd/sdk-vectors` in davinci-zkvm. Some
integers in them (vote ids, slots) exceed 2^53; `test/helpers/fixtures.ts` reads
those as strings.

`dkg_schnorr.json`'s `description` still names a Poseidon transcript. The organizer
values in it were produced with the keccak transcript that `rust-sdk/src/dkg.rs` and
davinci-dkg's `DKGAppManager` use, which is the one the SDK implements.

To refresh: copy the files from a newer davinci-zkvm, update the commit and the
checksums here, and re-run `yarn test:unit`.

```
(cd test/fixtures/zkvm && sha256sum *.json *.rs)
```
